FN-JGX6YFF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 206
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 206 as introduced would reduce annual motor vehicle registration receipts to various
local licensing officials and the Department of Corrections by an estimated $28,000,
cumulatively, by lowering the disability rating threshold for receiving a disabled veteran license
plate.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 206
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, & Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Public Safety
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2024
House Bill 206 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce annual motor vehicle
registration receipts to various local licensing officials and the Department of Corrections by an
estimated $28,000, cumulatively, by lowering the disability rating threshold for receiving a
disabled veteran license plate.
